_comment: Which locales search engines may index. Every active locale stays published and reachable through the language switcher; a locale not listed in 'indexed' gets <meta name="robots" content="noindex, follow"> on every page, is left out of every sitemap, and is removed from every hreflang cluster. Read by scripts/lib/_locale_indexing.py, the only consumer. English only since v0.0.45: the 11 Sep 2026 site-wide demotion followed ~1,600 machine-translated pages and ~1,200 URL renames in late August, and keeping ten machine-translated locales indexable (v0.0.30) did not recover it. French is indexed again since v0.0.47 on the author's decision (ADR-0015, amendment of 22 Nov 2026); every other locale stays out until its translations are human-reviewed. 'en' must always be listed.
